evals.prompt: In Python, load a USD scene and clone /World/envs/env0 into env1..env3 for batched simulation. Wait so bindings can see the clones.
evals.expected_output: A Python flow that installs and registers the external PhysX and Newton schemas before population, attaches the populated ovstage, calls PhysX.clone with the source and target paths before warmup or the first step, then wait_all before creating bindings.
expectations: Selects clone-environments
Clones before warmup() or the first simulation step
Calls physx.clone(source, targets) then wait_all (or equivalent wait)
Does not claim clone authors new USD prims for the targets
Registers both PhysX resource directories from physx_schema_paths() and the Newton root from ovphysx.newton_schema_root() with ovstage.population.register_usd_schemas before the first population call
If the example selects CPU mode, gives each clone a spatially disjoint anchor_transforms pose
Installs physx-usd-schemas and newton-usd-schemas separately from ovphysx and locates their schema resources without importing either provider or USD
Registers PhysX and Newton schemas unconditionally before population or stock-USD schema-registry access; does not call retired PhysX schema-location APIs such as codeless_schema_paths

evals.prompt: Clone /env0/Robot to /env1/Robot and /env2/Robot with explicit world poses for each target root.
evals.expected_output: Uses anchor_transforms with one (px,py,pz,qx,qy,qz,qw) pose per target, matching targets length.
expectations: Uses anchor_transforms (not a deprecated name)
Provides one 7-float transform per target with len(anchor_transforms) == len(targets)
Explains the pose anchors the exact target subtree root world pose

evals.prompt: I already stepped the sim once. Can I call clone now to add more environments?
evals.expected_output: Rejects post-step cloning for this workflow; clone must happen before warmup or the first step.
expectations: States clone must run before warmup() or the first simulation step
Does not present post-step cloning as supported in this skill

evals.prompt: Author a .usda falling-box scene for ovphysx from scratch.
expectations: Does not select clone-environments for USD authoring
Selects ovphysx-usd-authoring

evals.prompt: I run ovphysx in CPU-only mode. Can I omit anchor_transforms and rely on env_ids to collision-isolate co-located cloned environments?
evals.expected_output: Explains that PhysX environment ids isolate clones only under GPU dynamics and GPU broadphase. Recommends spatially disjoint anchor_transforms for CPU clones and names the log channel that reports the unavailable isolation.
expectations: States that env_ids do not provide cross-environment collision isolation in CPU mode
Recommends spatially disjoint anchor_transforms for CPU clones
Does not recommend co-locating CPU clones
Names enable_python_logging() or ovphysx_set_log_callback() as the way to observe the runtime's EnvIds warning, and does not claim clone() raises or emits a Python warning

evals.prompt: My stage is already attached to an ovphysx::PhysX instance. Show a small C++ example that clones /World/envs/env0 twice and waits, with automatic cleanup of the wait result.
evals.expected_output: A complete C++ function using PhysX::clone, checking the admission status, and holding the result of PhysX::waitTask in an ovphysx::physx::WaitResult whose destructor releases the native result.
expectations: Clones before warmup or the first simulation step and provides spatially separated anchor transforms
Checks the clone receipt status before calling PhysX::waitTask
Uses ovphysx::physx::WaitResult and checks its status() for the execution outcome
Relies on WaitResult destruction instead of manually destroying or shallow-copying its native result

evals.prompt: Before cloning /World/envs/env0, I populate a USD whose source box has a translated parent, but the box loads at its local position. Which population mask should the clone example use?
evals.expected_output: Uses PopulationDomain.ALL before sealing and attaching, so OVStage 0.3 resolves nested world transforms via the rendering domain.
expectations: Uses domains=ovstage.PopulationDomain.ALL for initial USD population
Explains that PHYSICS-only population seeds world matrices with local values in the pinned OVStage 0.3 release
Seals the populated ordinal before attach_ovstage and collects the attach task before dependent operations
